text: dsh-cinematic-workflow 是 DSH 的人工把关电影制作流程插件，通过 /cinema 命令和工具管理素材分析、粗剪、调色、精剪及交付。它生成本地媒体元数据清单、记录创作选择和阶段报告、校验必需制品，并从审阅过的剪辑决策表生成 FCPXML。每阶段须由用户确认后继续，项目资料默认保存在工作区 .dsh/cinematic。

dsh-cinematic-workflow adds a human-reviewed film process to DSH. /cinema commands inventory local media, record creative choices and reports, check stage deliverables, and create FCPXML from a reviewed edit list. Users approve each stage; project data is stored in the workspace.
想让 DSH 帮我按阶段整理一部旅行电影的制作过程。
我需要把本地视频素材盘点成可供剪辑规划使用的清单。
怎样让 DSH 辅助构思影片主题和情绪弧线，但由我决定创意方向？
我想把审阅过的剪辑决策表转换成 Final Cut Pro 可导入的时间线文件。
能不能在每个制作阶段完成后检查报告和交付物是否齐全？
我希望项目记录和素材清单都保存在本地工作区。
Help me organize a film project into stages while I approve each step.
Turn my local footage folder into a metadata inventory for planning an edit.
dsh-cinematic-workflow 的功能「素材清单」：递归盘点项目中的音视频文件，记录路径、大小、格式和修改时间到本地 JSON。只收集元数据，不声称理解影片内容。
dsh-cinematic-workflow 的功能「人工审核阶段」：用户通过 /cinema continue 确认当前阶段；系统检查必需制品和创作选择，条件齐备后才标记阶段通过并切换到下一阶段。
dsh-cinematic-workflow 的功能「生成 FCPXML」：粗剪阶段根据帧率和剪辑片段输入生成 FCPXML 1.14 文件，并登记到项目制品中，供用户自行导入剪辑软件。
dsh-cinematic-workflow 的功能「阶段制品校验」：运行 /cinema validate 或 cinema_validate，检查当前阶段缺少的必需制品和人工选择，并核对已登记文件的哈希是否变化。

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · dsh-cinematic-workflow：Local-first, human-gated authorial film workflow for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It turns a cinematic travel-film directing workflow into a real DSH plugin: media inventory, creative direction, rough-cut deliverables, import-ready FCPXML, Resolve handoff, restrained copy/subtitles, QC and delivery records. It is intentionally **not** a mouse macro for Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · dsh-cinematic-workflow：The central rule is enforced in code: a stage never advances unless a human runs `/cinema continue <project-id>` and the current stage has its required deliverables. Models cannot approve, skip, merge, or pre-run future stages.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Install：```bash
dsh profile install npm:dsh-cinematic-workflow
```

Restart or reload the DSH profile after installation. The package targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`; Harness is a developer preview, so pin compatible versions when upgrading.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Quick start：```text
/cinema doctor
/cinema start "/path/to/footage" --title "My film" --preset travel-authorial
/cinema run <project-id>
```

Review the current stage. Record creative choices without moving forward:

```text
/cinema choose <project-id> theme "freedom"
/cinema choose <project-id> arc "arrival → release → quiet afterglow"
/cinema continue <project-id>
```

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Workflow：| Stage | Required human-reviewed deliverables |
| --- | --- |
| Sample (optional) | Style database |
| Analysis | Media inventory, director notebook, creative baseline, chosen arc |
| Rough cut | EDL, FCPXML, sound plan, director review |
| Grade | Grade brief, Resolve return artifact |
| Finishing | Copy script, subtitles, finishing timeline |
| Delivery | QC report, delivery manifest |

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Workflow：Use `/cinema status`, `/cinema validate`, `/cinema revise`, and `/cinema attach` at any time. `/cinema run` queues only the current stage; it cannot advance the project.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Media and NLE integration：- The base inventory is automatic metadata collection only; it never claims to have viewed complete footage.
- Install FFmpeg/FFprobe if you want to add external contact-sheet or QC helpers in your own workflow. The plugin remains usable without it.
- `cinema_build_fcpxml` generates FCPXML 1.14 from a reviewed EDL. It does not import it into Final Cut Pro.
- Resolve v0.1 produces a handoff brief; you import/export in Resolve and attach the returned file with `/cinema attach`.
- Source media is never moved, renamed, transcoded, overwritten, or uploaded.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Privacy and provenance：Project records live in `<workspace>/.dsh/cinematic/` and are intended to be gitignored. Artifact observations are labelled `automatic`, `model-inference`, `human-confirmed`, or `unresolved`. Do not publish project folders containing private absolute paths, GPS data, face metrics, or personal media.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Creative principle：Priority is: creator expression > story > audience emotion > shot language > sound > colour > editing technique > software operation. The bundled `travel-authorial` preset prefers first-person observation, breathing room, environmental sound and restrained copy over tourism, advertising, flashy transitions or constant music.

dsh-cinematic-workflow README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```
